message.content:
I need to understand the mapping between an Avro CDC schema and LegacyProductData.kt.

The Avro schema is at: domain/cdc/src/main/avro/cmn.pricecompare-be-team.cdc.mongo.shopping.products.v1-value.avsc
The target DTO is at: domain/index/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/domain/index/dto/LegacyProductData.kt

Key things to investigate:
1. Find the LegacySyncMapper.kt (it's listed as modified in git status at application/index/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/application/index/mapper/LegacySyncMapper.kt) - read its full content
2. Find any other mappers or converters that transform the Avro-generated classes to LegacyProductData
3. Look for how channelDatas (a map in Avro) is flattened into individual fields (linkUrl, price, benefit, promotions, eventInfo) in LegacyProductData
4. Find the Avro-generated Java/Kotlin classes if they exist (check build directories or generated sources)
5. Check the ChangedDocument interface that LegacyProductData implements
6. Look for any existing tests for the mapper

Please provide the full content of all relevant files found.

    15→class LegacyReserveSyncListener(
    16→    private val legacyReserveSyncApplicationService: LegacyReserveSyncApplicationService,
    17→) : BatchAcknowledgingConsumerAwareMessageListener<SpecificRecord, SpecificRecord> {
    18→    private val logger by logger()
    19→
    20→    override fun onMessage(
    21→        data: List<ConsumerRecord<SpecificRecord, SpecificRecord>>,
    22→        acknowledgment: Acknowledgment?,
    23→        consumer: Consumer<*, *>,
    24→    ) {
    25→        runCatching {
    26→            val changedDocuments =
    27→                data
    28→                    .filter { record ->
    29→                        val envelope = record.value() as ProductCdcEnvelope
    30→                        val product = envelope.after ?: envelope.before
    31→                        product != null && product.categoryId > 0
    32→                    }.map { it.toChangedProductData() }
    33→
    34→            val mergedDocuments = ProductMergeStrategy.merge(changedDocuments)
    35→            legacyReserveSyncApplicationService.syncToLegacy(LegacySyncMapper.convertToChangedLegacyData(mergedDocuments))
    36→        }.onSuccess {
    37→            acknowledgment?.acknowledge()
    38→        }.onFailure { ex ->
    39→            logger.error(ex) { "Failed to sync products to legacy" }
    40→        }.getOrThrow()
    41→    }
